question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Any resemblance of a character in this book to a living person is ______ incidental.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Purely**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Purely** means **without a doubt, 100%, or completely**.
 
• The fiction genre of books and movies uses various names and characteristics so the resemblance is possible, but it's not on purpose.
 
• The makers invest years developing characters uniquely so if it matches with someone it's purely incident.
 
• The correct sentence would be, **Any resemblance of a character in this book to a living person is purely incidental**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Absolutely** means **surely or totally**.

 
 
• Example, ***Liam is absolutely sure about going on the trip***.
 
 
 
• **Naturally** means **without interference or help**.
 
 
• Example, ***People naturally become Maya's friends***.
 
 
 
• **Thoroughly** means **in detail or properly**
 
 
• Example,*** I checked my room thoroughly yesterday for my other sock.***
